concerns.text: Task T005a (Implement validation logic) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly states in its description: 'Dependency: Requires T006-Write and T007-Write to exist before this script is written or executed. NOT Parallel with schema definition tasks.' This is a direct contradiction. A task cannot be parallel-safe if it has a hard dependency on the completion of other tasks in the same phase. The [P] tag must be removed.

Task T008b (Implement precheck) is marked [P] but depends on T008a (selected_ids.txt). The description explicitly states 'Dependency: Depends on T008a.' and 'Removed [P] tag to reflect serial dependency chain.' However, the task header still retains the [P] tag. This violates the producer-consumer ordering rule and the [P] correctness lens.

Task T008c (Verify mirror) is marked [P] but the description states 'Removed [P] tag to reflect serial dependency chain.' The header tag contradicts the explicit dependency logic described in the text, creating a false parallel opportunity.

Task T008d-2 is marked [P] but the description states 'Dependency: Depends on T008c' and 'This task must run before T008d-3.' The [P] tag implies no dependencies, which is false. This violates the producer-consumer ordering rule.

Task T013-Models is marked [P] but the description states 'Requirement: This task MUST be completed before T013.' and 'Dependency: This task depends on T008d-3 and T013-Models' (circular self-reference in dependency list, but clearly implies T013-Models must precede T013). If T013-Models is a prerequisite for T013, it cannot be parallel with T013 or other tasks that depend on T013. The [P] tag is misleading in the context of the US1 block flow.

Task T014b is marked [P] but the description states 'Dependency: This task depends on T013 and T004.' and 'CRITICAL: T014b cannot be executed until T013 is complete.' The [P] tag is incorrect as it has a hard dependency on T013.

Task T014c-Select is marked [P] but the description states 'Dependency: This task depends on T004, T014, and T014b.' and 'CRITICAL: T014c-Select cannot be executed until T014 and T014b are complete.' The [P] tag is invalid.

Task T015 is marked [P] but the description states 'Dependency: This task depends on T013, T014, T014b, T016a, T016b.' and 'CRITICAL: T015 cannot be executed until T013 is complete.' The [P] tag is invalid.
Task T015-Write is marked [P] but the description states 'Dependency: Depends on T015.' The [P] tag is invalid.
Task T017 is marked [P] but the description states 'Dependency: This task depends on T015 (which exposes counts) and T013, T014.' The [P] tag is invalid.
Task T021-2 is marked [P] but the description states 'Dependency: This task depends on T021-1.' and 'Note: Removed [P] tag to reflect serial dependency.' The header tag contradicts the text.
Task T022a-Transform is marked [P] but the description states 'Dependency: This task depends on T021-2.' and 'Note: Removed [P] tag to reflect serial dependency.' The header tag contradicts the text.
Task T027-Aggregate is marked [P] but the description states 'Dependency: Depends on T022a-Transform, T022b, T023, T024, T029, T030.' The [P] tag is invalid.
Task T027-Validate is marked [P] but the description states 'Dependency: Depends on T027-Aggregate.' The [P] tag is invalid.
Task T033-Generate is marked [P] but the description states 'Dependency: Depends on T027-Validate, T030, T031.' The [P] tag is invalid.
Task T033-Write is marked [P] but the description states 'Dependency: Depends on T033-Generate.' The [P] tag is invalid.
